fields.label: Small heading above
fields.value: Understanding the experience

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What is The Anxious Patient Experience™?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The Anxious Patient Experience™ begins with a dedicated 70-minute Anxious New Patient Experience.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: This first visit follows a consistent APE protocol and flow that is unique to the programme. Before you arrive, we learn about your anxiety, triggers, previous experiences, communication preferences and what helps you feel more comfortable and in control.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: During your appointment, we take time to understand what helps you feel more at ease. We create a sense of predictability and control, communicate in the way that works best for you, and support you with practical ways to regulate your nervous system throughout your care.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Your visit may also include an examination, X-rays and other appropriate care (such as a clean) where you feel comfortable enough to proceed.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: From there, you receive a personalised treatment plan and ongoing APE care pathway, so future treatment can be adapted around your individual needs, preferences and level of support.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The aim is not to promise that anxiety disappears or to ask you to push through it.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: It is to help you understand your response, give you practical tools to regulate it, and create a consistent care pathway that helps anxiety become less of a barrier to receiving dental treatment.

fields.label: Small heading above
fields.value: The nervous system

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Dental anxiety often starts in the body.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Your nervous system is always checking whether you are safe. At the dentist, many things can tell it you are not:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Unfamiliar environments

fields.label: List item
fields.value: People you don’t know

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Lack of control

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Past experiences

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Claustrophobia

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Needles

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Sounds and sensations

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Embarrassment

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Unpredictability

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What it can feel like

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: When your body feels unsafe, you might notice:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A racing heart

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Muscle tension

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Changes in your breathing

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Shaking

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Nausea

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Tears

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Freezing

fields.label: List item
fields.value: The urge to leave or cancel

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: This is not always a conscious choice. It is your body trying to protect you.

fields.label: Small heading above
fields.value: Our approach

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: We don’t ask you to ignore that response. We work with it.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Being told to “just relax” rarely helps. Instead, we help you understand what is happening and introduce practical, evidence-informed strategies drawn from established approaches to anxiety regulation. Alongside greater predictability, control and personalised support, these tools can help you regulate your response and make accessing dental care feel more manageable.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Who is The Anxious Patient Experience™ for?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The Anxious Patient Experience™ is designed for people whose dental anxiety, fear or previous experiences make attending the dentist or receiving treatment more difficult.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You do not need to have severe dental phobia to benefit from the experience. You may simply notice that your heart races before an appointment, you feel tense in the waiting room, you avoid booking, feel embarrassed or overwhelmed, or wish dental care felt easier.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The Anxious Patient Experience™ is not intended as a standalone pathway for patients with severe dental phobia who are unable to tolerate dental care without significant pharmacological support.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For some patients, inhalation sedation, such as nitrous oxide, intravenous sedation, or referral for treatment under general anaesthetic may be more appropriate.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our role is to help identify the level of support that is right for you rather than asking you to force yourself through an approach that may not be appropriate.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Dr Lorna Gladwin

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Creator of The Anxious Patient Experience™

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Lorna created The Anxious Patient Experience™ after seeing how often anxiety, rather than the dentistry itself, becomes the biggest barrier to someone receiving care.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Her approach has always centred around understanding the person before the teeth: what makes them anxious, what helps them feel in control, how they prefer to communicate, and what can make treatment feel more manageable.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Originally from northern England, Lorna graduated from the University of Sheffield in 2019 and has worked across NHS hospitals, private practice and referral settings in both the UK and Sydney. She now practises in the Sutherland Shire, with particular interests in restorative dentistry and endodontics.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The Anxious Patient Experience™ brings together the way she has naturally approached anxious patients throughout her career into a structured pathway designed to help more people access dental care with greater understanding, control and confidence.

fields.label: Quote
fields.value: “You don’t have to be brave here. You can take it one gentle step at a time.”

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: APE Lead | Patient Care & Support

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: As your first point of contact for The Anxious Patient Experience™, Alex is here to make you feel welcomed, supported and understood from the very beginning.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: With a background in dentistry and a genuine passion for patient care, Alex understands just how overwhelming a visit to the dentist can feel. Her warm, compassionate nature helps create a safe, judgement-free space where you can share your worries, ask questions and feel truly heard.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: What Alex loves most about her role is the opportunity to make a genuine difference in someone’s experience. Whether it’s offering a little reassurance, taking the time to listen or simply being a friendly, familiar face, Alex wants every patient to feel cared for, comfortable and confident taking the next step.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For Alex, it’s about more than just an appointment. It’s about making sure you feel like a person, not just another patient.

Whether it’s a comforting conversation, a gentle word of encouragement or simply holding your hand when you need a little extra support, Lauren is there to make sure you never feel alone in the chair.

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Paragraph

fields.label: Small heading above
fields.value: Questions

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Everything you might want to know before you begin.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Am I suitable for The Anxious Patient Experience™?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If your body tenses, your heart races or you avoid the dentist because of how it makes you feel, this was created for you. It may not be sufficient on its own for everyone. More severe dental phobia or complex cases may need additional support, which we will discuss with you.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What happens after I book?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Once your appointment is confirmed, we’ll send you your Anxious Patient Experience new patient information pack.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: This will include your pre-appointment questionnaire, contact information, where to park, how to plan your day and everything you need to know before your visit - helping remove as much uncertainty as possible before you arrive.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The information you share also gives your dental team time to understand your anxiety, triggers and preferences and prepare your experience around you.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What if I haven’t been to the dentist for years?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You are not alone, and there is no judgement here. We start from where you are today.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What if I become overwhelmed or cry?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: That’s okay. It’s a natural response, not something to apologise for. We pause, give you time and only continue when you are ready.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Do I have to have treatment at my first appointment?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: No. Your first appointment is about understanding you and what you need. Any treatment is discussed and planned with you, at your pace.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Can I bring someone with me?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. You’re welcome to bring someone you trust.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Can I use headphones or choose what I watch or listen to?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. We have sound-reducing headphones ready for APE patients, along with weighted blankets if these help you feel more comfortable.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We’ll also ask about your music and TV preferences before your appointment so the room can be prepared for you where possible.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Is sedation available?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. Some patients find that additional support such as inhalation sedation, including nitrous oxide, or intravenous sedation makes dental care feel more manageable.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: These options can be discussed with you where appropriate.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The aim is not to take support away from you. We also want to help you understand your anxiety and build practical ways to regulate your response, so you have more tools available to you when receiving dental care.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What happens after my first appointment?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We talk through what we learned together and agree on the next steps. You decide what happens next and when.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: How much does it cost?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The New Patient Appointment is 70 minutes and costs $350. Health fund rebates are available. A $100 deposit is required to secure your booking.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What is the cancellation and deposit policy?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: With 48 hours’ notice or more, your deposit can be transferred or refunded. With less than 48 hours’ notice or non-attendance, your deposit may be retained. If anxiety is making it hard to attend, please contact us rather than simply not attending.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Still have a question?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Alex, our APE Lead, is happy to talk it through with you.
